# VC-PW-5320

Nobody froze the order.
The slot uses the SDR-480 case.
The reserved space is a real supply, not a box.
MEAN WELL is the manufacturer.
The company is Enterprises Co., Ltd.
The source file is `SDR-480.stp`.

- The source URL is https://www.meanwell.com/upload/pdf/SDR-480/SDR-480-3D.zip
- The STEP file is 5.5 MB.
- The file in this folder is that file from the manufacturer.
- `Rot(0, 0, -90)` maps the file onto the plate.
- Local X is the rail width, at 85.5 mm.
- Local Y is the depth, at 129.2 mm.

The curved terminal cover is at positive Y.
Local Z is the height, at 125.2 mm.
The vent grid is on the top face.
The rating of VC-PW-5320 stays open.
Do not treat this file as a purchase order for SDR-480-24.
